_comment: Copy to users.json and edit. Maps Telegram numeric user IDs to who that person is. This is BOTH the whitelist and the identity map -- a Telegram user not listed here is silently ignored, and the name is what 'my'/'I'/'me' resolves to when the bot searches the wiki. Get each ID from @userinfobot on Telegram. Keys starting with _ are ignored, so this comment is safe to leave in.

111111111.name: Jane Doe
111111111.notes: Primary wiki owner. Subscriber on the family health plan.
